Overview

Diyarbakir is a city in Diyarbakır with a population of 1,783,000. A historic city on the Tigris River, known for its black basalt city walls and rich Kurdish culture. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 280 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.0.
